critical_code_review_comments: backend/routers/fahrkontrolle.py — FkNoteIn/FkNotePatch/FkNote now include `image_url` (default ''). Create+patch persist correctly; empty string clears. text-only path still works. OK.

backend/models/schemas.py — StudentCreate/StudentPatch include `company` (Optional[str] with default ''). PATCH accepts '' to clear and returns updated field. Serialization drops mongo _id — good hygiene. OK.

frontend/src/pages/AdminStudentDetail.jsx L41-55 — `ageFromBirthdate` correctly handles ISO strings with proper before-birthday adjustment (does age -= 1 when today's mm-dd is before birthdate's mm-dd). Returns null on invalid input → no false badge. Solid.

frontend/src/pages/AdminStudentDetail.jsx L145-160 — `<span data-testid='student-minor-badge'>` only renders when `age != null && age < 18`. Correctly hidden for adults and for students without birthdate. UI matches spec (red pill, ShieldAlert icon, ‘Unter 18 · {age}J’).

frontend/src/pages/AdminStudentDetail.jsx L166 — student.company is threaded into the header meta line (‘Kat. B · Bubikon · PlaywrightFirma AG · Nadine’) — nice UX touch that mirrors visible edit change immediately after blur-save.

frontend/src/components/admin/students/LessonsTab.jsx L94 — `notesByDate` memo groups Diverse Notizen by ISO date key, then each `LessonCard` receives `linkedNotes={notesByDate[dateKey(l.date)] || []}` (L198). Clean O(N) grouping — no per-card re-scan.

frontend/src/components/admin/students/LessonsTab.jsx L329-352 — Linked-notes footer testids `lesson-card-linked-notes-{n}` + item `lesson-linked-note-{noteId}` + image `lesson-linked-note-image-{n}` correctly wired.
